task.title: Step 01: ISSUE-FIXER root-cause diagnosis for GH-791 / ISS-0706
task.description: Produce a structured root-cause diagnosis for GH-791 (GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup pre-flight blocks zig build bench on fresh/main DB). Read the actual migration file and the bench provisioning path. Confirm or refine the root cause recorded in ISS-0706, identify the EXACT branch point in the code/migration, and recommend the candidate fix approach (a, b, or c from the GH body). DO NOT propose a fix in detail — that's Step 02 (CODE-DESIGNER). DO write a structured diagnosis file at handoffs/WF03-GH791-20260815/diagnosis-01.md.

relevant_files: tests/integration/ env01_test.zig (current bench path used for env01)
context.known_symptom: zig build bench fails at the migrate prerequisite with 'TNT-07 pre-flight failed: tnt05_progress table does not exist. Run GBL-074 and GBL-075 first.' or 'TNT-07 pre-flight failed. Unready tenants: ...' on a fresh bench DB. Discovered during WF02-plc-batch-b-20260815 Step 05 RELEASE-VALIDATOR (NFR gate) and Step 06 DOC-UPDATER. The CI fresh-database path passes 146/146 (different provisioning).
candidate_fixes: (a) Make the bench DB provisioning path run GBL-074/GBL-075 + TNT-05 backfill before GBL-116.
(b) Relax the pre-flight gate for the bench seed tenant (env-only / anon / specific tenant_id).
(c) Document/script a bench-specific migrate path that satisfies the gate; gate stays strict for production.

diagnosis_required_sections: ## Gating logic (the exact pre-flight block in GBL-116 — quote the relevant SQL)
## Why CI path is unaffected (different provisioning; explain how)
## Why bench path is affected (default tenant has no tenant_schemas row with migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL OR no tnt05_progress row with status='COMPLETED')
## Candidate fix approaches (a, b, c) — PROs / CONs / blast radius
## Recommendation (which approach to take and why, but NOT yet the actual patch)

verification.root_cause_confirmed: CONFIRMED (refined: bench DB has two compounding defects — migrate.zig hard-reads BPM_DB_URL which the bench never sets; provisionTenantSchema hook fails silently leaving migrations_applied_at NULL; GBL-116 Branch 2 pre-flight trips on the default tenant)
verification.quoted_block_in_gbl_116: migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql lines 17-62 (the DO $$ ... BEGIN ... pre-flight block, in particular lines 25-34 'tnt05_progress table does not exist' branch and lines 53-61 'Unready tenants' RAISE EXCEPTION)
verification.recommendation: a (composed with new candidate d: also fail loudly inside migrate.zig when provisionTenantSchema returns MigrationFailed instead of swallowing the error)

result.summary: Root cause confirmed at migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql:53-61 (Branch 2 pre-flight trips because migrations_applied_at IS NULL for default tenant). Underlying cause is twofold: (1) tests/bench/bench.zig resolves BPM_BENCH_DB_URL but migrate.zig hard-reads BPM_DB_URL so the in-loop provisionTenantSchema hook either never runs or runs against the wrong DB; (2) when provisionTenantSchema does run and fails (MigrationFailed inside runForSchema), migrate.zig:186 silently swallows the error and leaves migrations_applied_at NULL, so GBL-116 Branch 2 fires. Recommendation: approach (a) — inject BPM_DB_URL into the migrate child process from the bench step — composed with new candidate (d) — fail loudly inside migrate.zig when the post-condition (migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL) is not satisfied after provisionTenantSchema returns. CI fresh-DB path unaffected because .github/workflows/ci.yml:441 sets BPM_DB_URL explicitly in the step env block.
result.root_cause_location: migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql:53-61 (Branch 2 pre-flight RAISE EXCEPTION, with underlying silent-failure cause in src/tools/migrate.zig:186)
result.next_action: Route to Step 02 CODE-DESIGNER for fix design (composed: bench step sets BPM_DB_URL via setEnvironmentVariable; migrate.zig adds post-condition check on tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at)
